verdict.rationale: Twenty documents its own migration path: CSV/XLSX/XLS import for any object with column-to-field mapping, duplicate detection and in-UI error fixing, plus unlimited API import with batch create and upsert for large migrations. Related records can be linked by unique keys, including Workspace Member email, which plausibly preserves owner assignments. There are no native connectors from other CRMs, and nothing documents carrying over activity or history; email sync only links mail from connected mailboxes going forward. Missing for 10: direct importers from specific CRMs, documented import of historical activities, notes and timeline, an explicit owner-mapping walkthrough, and independent hands-on migration reports.
